WITH profile_avgs AS (
  SELECT
    o.weathprofile,
    AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct,
    COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescopes AS t
  INNER JOIN observatories AS o
    ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  WHERE t.detecttempk > 152.1
  GROUP BY o.weathprofile
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_bandusagepct) AS mean_profile_avg
  FROM profile_avgs
)
SELECT
  p.weathprofile,
  p.avg_bandusagepct,
  p.telescope_count,
  p.avg_bandusagepct - o.mean_profile_avg AS difference_from_mean
FROM profile_avgs AS p
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE o.mean_profile_avg IS NOT NULL;
